svg.title: TOPAK C2 — Alphabets by seat: nine variants and a control alphabet of six, two domains, five seat kinds
svg.desc: Each domain has its own typed alphabet and no variant name is shared; only the carrier, epoch and lease on every action, is common. Which seat kind may express which variant is bounded twice: by the grant path, which refuses an alphabet outside the kind's row, and by the policy floor at admit (ADR-0037 §4, ADR-0043 §2). Since Batch 34 an operator seat holds no variant at all and speaks a control alphabet of six, and an emergency seat speaks Run's three; both kinds are provisional (ADR-0037 A3, A4). The floor cited is the proposed floor's emergency stage, genesis-provisional, not ratified (G10 §2.2).
svg.text: TOPAK · C2

Which seat kind may express which variant is bounded twice: by the grant path, which refuses an alphabet outside the kind's row, and by the policy floor at admit (ADR-0037 §4, ADR-0043 §2). Run offers nothing to a gate: a Run round ends when its lease ends, and a Run seat cannot abstain (ADR-0040 §4; ADR-0042 §5). A principal that has finished holds its lease until it lapses. An emergency seat speaks these three
and nothing else (ADR-0052 §1).
Egress only: the alphabet types what a principal does, not what it receives (ADR-0022 §1)
Three variants, nothing shared but the carrier (ADR-0040 §1, §2)

to carry the same obligations in both:

have an effect.
So a floor entry, a lease's alphabet
and a log line each name their domain
by the verb.

text.tspan: The carrier is shared: every action carries epoch and lease (ADR-0022 §2; ADR-0040 §2)

svg.text: Actions under a fenced epoch are rejected by the mechanism, not by policy, ahead of the floor; the floor states no epoch fence (its header). The lease (ADR-0031) carries the seat, its alphabet and its domain; at the reference the bearer token carries (seat, lease, epoch) into every action, and a lease the launcher issues mints none: at rung 1 the bridge is the session (mechanism/ I14; ADR-0033 A7, B29). Under an emergency lease every action carries a proof signed with the person's key, and there is
no bearer token (A12). An operator's request carries the fleet epoch in its signed body (A11).

Not action variants. An operator seat is issued none (ADR-0037 A4; SeatKind::Operator admits none at the reference). Each request is signed with the seat's key, carries the fleet epoch and a counter, and is decided by the floor's C1 to C9 over thirteen facts the mechanism computes; every replica recomputes them and restates the envelope at apply (ADR-0033 A11). First leases are not here: the mechanism grants one when a quorum completes (ADR-0050 §2), which is not built; at the reference the unsigned
socket stands in as a BOOTSTRAP path. Issue and BreakGlassApprove are not operator variants.
Three adds, which need a live lease and a live peer; three denies, which need no lease but a Persona in force and a fresh credential (ADR-0050 §4, §6)
Corpus root: a pinned, content-addressed set; Read is scoped to it. Whether it is poisoned is an Observer finding, not an
enforcement decision.
Tool allowlist: name plus digest; each entry carries a hermeticity obligation: no network, no filesystem outside the
workspace, deterministic given its inputs. A Build entry has no channel and no labels, and one that declares a channel
does not load (ADR-0049).
Round bound: maximum actions per round; termination, and it bounds the state space.
Run root: a second pinned, content-addressed set; Consult is scoped to it, and declares a label (ADR-0040 A1).
Tool allowlist: name plus digest, in ADR-0049's one form: identity, inputs, interface, labels and channel. A Run tool is not
hermetic and is not asked to be; the channel's target is declared once, in the entry (ADR-0049 §5; ADR-0033 A9).
Round bound R: admits per round over all three variants; per domain; a placeholder number.
One allowlisted tool with a socket collapses the envelope to vacuity (ADR-0022 Negative).
Wasm components: discharged by construction, ADR-0034 P4: instantiated per call, a workspace directory capability
only; no sockets, no wall clock, no free entropy.
Native tools: unowned. Using one is declared degeneracy D-0034-3: P4 falsified, the principals reaching it are Mediated
At the reference a Build profile that says P4 passes is not yet held to Wasm tools for Invoke (G10 item 83, as at G9).
P4 cannot hold for a Run tool; channel fidelity replaces it: a tool opens the channel its entry declares and no other
(ADR-0042 §6, in force since Batch 30).
Owner: ADR-0034 A2, the Run profile (B30): the tool host's Wasm runtime hands a Run tool one network capability, its
declared target. ADR-0033 A8 (B31) builds it; A9 (B32) reads the target from the entry in the revision the lease names,
and from nowhere else (G10 item 84, closed).
Native Run tools: D-0034-6, or D-0034-5 behind an egress filter, a trust (G19).
Run principals are still Mediated in fact: Contained has four conjuncts and the lineage criterion is not in force (ToO §2.9;

Only a thinker seat, or in Run an emergency seat for Actuate, holds a variant that writes, runs or offers (Draft, Invoke, Submit, Actuate), and B10 names both; a thinker seat never votes (ADR-0037 §4, A3). An operator seat holds no action variant, and nothing else holds the control alphabet (A4). A Reader with Draft authority, the failure ADR-0022's follow-up named, cannot arise: the Reader is not a principal. A narrower lease is always allowed (ADR-0031 §4), so an observer seat without
Consult needs no declaration (ADR-0043 §7); a lease cannot be narrowed to a tool, since its schema carries no tool set (ADR-0048 R6; G10 item 95).

Evaluation: any satisfied forbid denies; else any satisfied permit allows; else deny. Any evaluation error is a deny (ADR-0030 §1). Not in the floor, by design: epoch fencing (the mechanism, ahead of the floor), the round bound (a count), the rules floor (bounds issuances), Invoke hermeticity (a property of the allowlist entry), and first leases (granted by the mechanism on a quorum). The text is built in three gated stages from floor/genesis-floor.cedar (17 policies, a draft, unchanged): labels (20), control (29),

emergency (28). It is gated, pinned and enforced, and not ratified: the bootstrap reviewer ratifies it on finding it fit, and no test of fitness is written (ADR-0030 A3; G10 items 2, 87). Comments carried from the genesis text still call the floor DRAFT and ADR-0040 and ADR-0041 "Proposed", and the stage's opening comment, "not what the reference follows", is wrong; the bytes are kept as gated (G10 item 91).

Constants: 2 principals, 3 seats (one per kind), 4 actions. Each mutation breaks exactly its property: M_KIND (the grant path ignores the kind bound) and M_SEAT (one-live-lease keyed by seat, the reference's behaviour before R5).

Proved (ADR-0037 B25; ADR-0046 §4): Seats_proof.tla, 110 obligations, OnlyThinkersAuthor not under M_KIND and OneSeatPerPrincipal not under M_SEAT; RunSeats_proof.tla, 147 obligations, OnlyThinkersActuate not under M_KIND,

ObserversConsultAndReport not under M_KIND, M_DOMAIN, NoNameCrossesDomains not under M_DOMAIN. Of the modules, for every behaviour; the rows here stay with TLC. Certified (ADR-0046 A1): of 110, 107 by normalization or a checked proof and 3 LS4
steps; of 147, 143 and 4. LS4's answers no checker confirms.

Neither module has the two new kinds. They model three seats, one per kind of 2026.09.29. operator and emergency are checked by Operators.tla (32 rows, thirteen invariants, 354 obligations) and Emergency.tla (51 rows, six properties, 373
obligations), each proved and certified (G10 §3); the binding table has no rows for either (G10 item 90).

The binding table now agrees with these rows (ADR-0046 §5, correction 1): M_OBSEMIT breaks none of the three invariants, since it narrows an observer's bound and they are upper bounds, and M_DOMAIN breaks ObserversConsultAndReport as well as
NoNameCrossesDomains. The table had listed M_OBSEMIT and missed M_DOMAIN.

M_OBSEMIT is ADR-0037 §4's struck provisional Run column (an observer seat with emission only): every property holds and no Observer ever consults. The results file's header still reads "ADR-0043 §8, Proposed"; ADR-0043 was ratified in Batch 20.
